senses.zh_definition: 凯勒：一种源自德语的姓氏；这里按专有名词解释，不指某一特定人物。
senses.en_definition: Keller, a surname of German origin; no particular bearer is identified here.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal daripada bahasa Jerman; individu yang dimaksudkan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 输入没有上下文，故这里只提供姓氏这一候选解释，不能确认它就是原始语料中的所指。德语普通名词 Keller 另有“地下室”义，不能直接当作马来语词义。尚无证据支持 official 状态；搭配是专名使用示例，非高频统计结果；排名沿用输入。[姓氏资料](https://www.cbgfamilienamen.nl/nfb/detail_naam.php?gba_naam=Keller&info=documentatie&nfd_naam=Keller&operator=eq&taal=eng)，[德语普通名词 Keller](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Keller_Raum)

etymology.historical_story: Keller has several documented surname origins. One connects it with a medieval occupation involving the management of wine cellars, estates, or revenues. Another identifies someone by residence near a distinctive cellar. These histories explain the surname generally; they do not establish the ancestry of any particular person named Keller. [Surname documentation](https://www.cbgfamilienamen.nl/nfb/detail_naam.php?gba_naam=Keller&info=documentatie&nfd_naam=Keller&operator=eq&taal=eng)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Keller 的大写 K，就先想到姓氏“凯勒”；双写 ll 一起记住，不拆成马来语词根和词缀。
